nodes.name: Section 11, Theorem E, Theorem F: Analysis of LHS-spectral sequence Grosshans filtration properties
nodes.statement:
Finite group schemes over a field satisfy (CFG).

Let $k$ be a Noetherian ring.  Suppose that there is a morphism of $\mathrm{GL}_n$--algebras $f\colon B\to A$ such that both $B$ and $A$ are  finitely generated $k$--algebras,
         $B$ has a good filtration, and
         $f$ makes $A$ a Noetherian $B$--module.
     Then the following properties hold.
\begin{itemize}
    \item[$(a)$] $H^i(\mathrm{GL}_n,A)=0$ for $i$ large enough. 
    \item[$(b)$] $H^i(\mathrm{GL}_n,A)$ is a Noetherian $A^G$--module for every $i$.
\end{itemize}
In particular, this implies that $H^\ast(\mathrm{GL}_n,A)$ is a finitely generated $k$--algebra.

nodes.name: Corollary 10.33, Theorem 12.20, Theorem E, Theorem F: FG for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over a Noetherian base …
nodes.statement:
If $G$ is a Chevalley group scheme or a finite flat group scheme then it satisfies (FG) for every Noetherian base.

There are classes 
\[
c[i]\in H^{2i}(\mathrm{GL}_n,\Gamma^i(\mathfrak{gl}_n^{(1)}))
\]
where $\Gamma^i(\mathfrak{gl}_n^{(1)})$ denotes $((\mathfrak{gl}_n^{(1)})^\otimes i)^{\mathfrak{S}_i}$, satisfying the following properties. 
\begin{enumerate}
    \item $c[1]=e_1$ of Friedlander-Suslin.
    \item For every $i,j$ we have 
    \begin{align*}
        H^{2(i+j)}(\mathrm{GL}_n,\Gamma^{i+1}(\mathfrak{gl}_n^{(1)})) & \to H^{2(i+j)}(\mathrm{GL}_n, \Gamma^i(\mathfrak{gl}_n^{(1)})\otimes \Gamma^j(\mathfrak{gl}_n^{(1)}))\\ 
        c[i+j] & \mapsto c[i]\cup c[j].
    \end{align*}
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Corollary 10.33, Proposition 13.3: FG for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over a Noetherian base
nodes.statement:
If $G$ is a Chevalley group scheme or a finite flat group scheme then it satisfies (FG) for every Noetherian base.

If $H^*(G, A)$ has bounded torsion, then the reduction map 
    \[
    H^{\mathrm{even}}(G, A) \to H^{\mathrm{even}}(G, A/pA)
    \]
    is power surjective for every prime number $p$.
labels: Prop: power surjectivity on cohomology at a prime

nodes.name: Section 9, Theorem C: Reduction Embedding
nodes.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group scheme over a field, and $A$ be a finitely generated $G$--algebra. Then $H^\ast(G,A)$ has bounded torsion.

nodes.name: Theorem D: CFG for $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over a Noetherian ring containing a field
nodes.statement: Let $k$ be a commutative Noetherian ring containing a field. Then $\mathrm{GL}_n$ over $k$  satisfies (CFG).

nodes.name: Theorem B: $H^\ast(\mathrm{GL}_n,A)$ is a f g $k$ --alg $\Leftrightarrow$ it has bounded…
nodes.statement: Let $k$ be a Noetherian ring, $G'$ be a Chevalley group scheme over $k$, and $A$ be a $G'$--algebra over $k$ which is finitely generated over $k$. Then $H^\ast(G',A)$ is a finitely generated algebra if and only if the underlying abelian group $H^\ast(G',A)$ has bounded $\mathbb{Z}$--torsion.
